day_shape: Mojtaba Khamenei appoints Mohsen Rezaei as his SNSC representative and secretary, Trump signals "low-key" / "semi-negotiating" posture on Iran, CENTCOM reports 55 vessels redirected under Iran blockade, Iranian parliamentary commission passes Strait of Hormuz control law.

threads.label: Rezaei elevated to SNSC secretary
threads.summary: Khamenei's office announced the appointment of Mohsen Rezaei as the Supreme Leader's representative on and secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, with a separate decree naming Mohammad Baqir Zolghadar as political adviser. Iran International and regime channels reported the judiciary head and IRGC-linked figures issuing congratulatory messages.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and US blockade
threads.summary: CENTCOM said it has redirected 55 commercial vessels, disabled two and boarded two enforcing the US blockade against Iran, while Defa Press reported the parliamentary national security commission passed a law on control of the Strait of Hormuz. Iran said an Oman shipping-lane deal is in final stages, and IRGC commander Zolghadr said the strait will not reopen until Washington "corrects its behavior."

threads.label: Trump posture on Iran negotiations
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Trump saying the US is "only semi-negotiating" and intends to "low-key" the Iran issue, and is weighing declaring victory without a nuclear deal with Hormuz reopening as the key condition. UN Ambassador Mike Waltz told Fox News that Iranian negotiators fear Treasury Secretary Bessent and economic sanctions more than military action.

threads.label: Mojtaba Khamenei visibility questions
threads.summary: Iran's Mehr News Agency released an undated sub-15-second video of Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, and a Basij deputy said further public footage would be released. Iran International reported his continued absence from public view has produced an unusual system where decisions are issued through written messages.

threads.label: Israeli operations in Lebanon, Syria, West Bank
threads.summary: The IDF reported dismantling a Hezbollah underground tunnel weapons shaft and a 48-hour counterterrorism operation in Qalandiya Camp and Kafr Aqab, while IRIB claimed Israeli forces detonated homes in Majdalzoun and advanced into Tel Abu Qubis in Quneitra. A US Senate bill would provide the Lebanese Armed Forces $200 million annually to help disarm Hezbollah.

threads.label: Gaza pause and Trump disarmament plan
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported the Israeli pause on Gaza strikes has suspended the hunt for October 7 perpetrators, and Netanyahu reportedly told Jared Kushner he would give Trump's Hamas disarmament plan a chance with the IDF returning to the Yellow Line. A senior US official told Axios Washington "is not bothered" by Netanyahu's stance.

threads.label: Iranian domestic economic and rights pressure
threads.summary: Iran International reported average advertised Tehran rents above 720 million rials — roughly three times many workers' monthly pay — alongside falling dairy and red-meat consumption and patients foregoing treatment due to drug shortages. The Supreme Court upheld the death sentence of 28-year-old protester Rasoul Rezaei, and rights groups warned of an intensified crackdown on journalists.

events.title_en: Pilot trainee suicide in south of occupied territories
events.summary_en: Pilot trainee suicide in south of occupied territories. The Haaretz newspaper reported that a pilot trainee committed suicide yesterday morning inside a military base in the south of the occupied territories. This incident has occurred amid rising suicide cases within Israel's security apparatus since the start of the war on 7 October 2023. Last month, two female soldiers on active duty and one reserve soldier also committed suicide. According to Haaretz's investigation, at least 18 soldiers—on the basis of reported cases alone—have committed suicide since the beginning of this year.

events.title_en: Repercussions of the collapse of the Persian Gulf security doctrine in the Mecca Accord
events.summary_en: Repercussions of the collapse of the Persian Gulf security doctrine in the Mecca Accord. Riyadh's failure to secure domestic security and the ineffectiveness of Western weapons against Ansarallah forced the Al Saud to break out from the American umbrella and resort to the Mecca Accord. The formation of the Mecca security triangle should be seen as a direct reflection of the rupture in the traditional defence doctrine of the Persian Gulf. The core nucleus of this accord has a comparable interpretation to Article 5 of the NATO Charter, such that any military invasion of the territory or territorial integrity of any one of the signatories is considered a direct aggression against all members and will result in a unified armed, diplomatic and operational response. events.summary_en: Heavy rain and thunderstorms in north-west of the country and Alborz highlands. Meteorological Organisation: From today (Monday) to Thursday, in the north of West and East Azerbaijan provinces, Ardabil, the central and eastern Alborz highlands, cloud increase, occasional heavy rain and thunderstorms and temporary strong winds will occur. This situation will continue on Friday in the north of West Azerbaijan and the eastern Alborz highlands. Also over the next three days, in the highlands of south and west Fars, Hormozgan, south Kerman, Kohgiluyeh and Buyer Ahmad and south and south-east Sistan and Baluchestan, heavy rain and thunderstorms and strong winds will occur in the afternoon hours.

events.title_en: Appointment of Dr Zolghadar as political adviser to the Supreme Leader. The Leader of the Islamic Revolution, in a decree, appointed Mr Dr Zolghadar as his political adviser.
events.summary_en: Appointment of Dr Zolghadar as political adviser to the Supreme Leader. The Leader of the Islamic Revolution, in a decree, appointed Mr Dr Zolghadar as his political adviser. The text of the decree of His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Mujtaba Husseini Khamenei reads as follows: In the name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful. Esteemed brother, Mr Dr Mohammad Baqir Zolghadar. Given your valuable experiences, hereby I appoint you as my political adviser. I hope that in carrying out this responsibility and in advancing the ideals of the Islamic Revolution, under the attention of our master, His Eminence the Baqiyyatullah al-A'azam (may God hasten his return), you will be successful and supported. Seyyed Mujtaba Khamenei.
